statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (H : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)), Nat.card H.dualAnnihilator = Nat.card ((Fin n → ZMod p) ⧸ H)

plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0033 · Count missing directions by the cardinality of the dual annihilator

brief.en: Identify the annihilator with the dual of the quotient and count the finite vector spaces.
